findings.title: Semgrep finding: python.lang.compatibility.python36.python36-compatibility-Popen1
findings.description: the `errors` argument to Popen is only available on Python 3.6+

disposition.reason: The rule checks compatibility with Python versions below Drydock's supported runtime floor.
disposition.evidence: AGENTS.md, PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, and README.md require Python 3.9+; .github/workflows/ci.yml tests Python 3.9 and 3.12; Codex readiness rejects runtimes below 3.9.
